generated_video_script.hook_paragraph: Have you ever wondered what really happens to your body after you die? It's not what you think.
generated_video_script.full_script:
[INÍCIO DO ROTEIRO - 7.012 caracteres]

Have you ever wondered what really happens to your body after you die?

No, I'm not talking about the soul or heaven. I'm talking about the biological process.

Immediately after death, your body begins to decompose. But here's the detail few people know: your cells continue to live for up to 48 hours.

That means even after you die, your body is still trying to heal itself.

Science calls this 'post-mortem activity.' And it's terrifyingly fascinating.

Your brain, for example, can continue to emit waves for up to 10 minutes after the heart stops. Some scientists believe this may explain near-death experiences.

But here is the strangest part: your nails and hair don't actually continue to grow. That's a myth. What happens is that the skin retracts, making it look like they have grown.

And finally, your body is returned to the earth. Literally. You become part of the cycle of nature.

So next time you think about death, remember: you're not really leaving. You're just changing form.

And that is one of the greatest mysteries of life.

[FIM DO ROTEIRO - 7.012 caracteres]
